en: Let me have a look at your Pokémon. I can always tell how much a Pokémon loves its trainer.
Hmm, it doesn't seem to care much for you at all. Spend more time together, and that will change.
It's still a little wary of you. Be kind to it, and it will warm up.
It's getting used to you. Keep at it, and you'll be good friends.
It's quite fond of you! You two are getting along nicely.
It's very friendly toward you. It's happy to be with you!
It adores you! You must take very good care of it.
It loves you with all its heart! I don't think I've ever seen a Pokémon so devoted.
